jobs.description:
Are you passionate about people, communication, and business development? We are looking for a Junior Sales Advisor to join a well-established and respected financial institution in Belgium. This is an excellent opportunity for a young professional who wants to build a career in a customer-focused and commercial environment.

Client Details

Our client is a leading player in the financial services sector, known for its strong customer orientation, professional development opportunities, and collaborative culture. The company invests heavily in its employees and offers a stable environment where talent can grow and develop.

Description

• Build and maintain strong relationships with customers.
• Advise clients on products and services that match their needs.
• Support customers throughout their journey and provide excellent service.
• Identify commercial opportunities and contribute to business growth.
• Work closely with colleagues to ensure an outstanding customer experience.
• Participate in client meetings, follow-ups, and sales initiatives.

• Master's degree (field of study is not important).
• Fluent in French, Dutch, and English.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Commercial mindset with a genuine interest in sales and customer relationships.
• Proactive, dynamic, and eager to learn.
• Team player with a positive attitude.

As a production worker, you will work together with a colleague every day to manufacture safety boots 👢. You will place components such as the steel toe cap, lining and sole into the mould. The machine automatically injects the plastic, after which you remove the finished boot. In between production runs, you clean the machine to ensure it is ready for the next production cycle.

After training, you will also be able to operate other machines. You will cut away larger excess pieces and trim fine seams ✂️. You will carry out quality checks and pay close attention to detail. Every boot must meet strict quality standards. With your keen eye for detail, you make sure that only top-quality products leave the facility.

Working together with your colleagues is important. You step in where needed and support each other in achieving the production targets. You work accurately and take pride in the end result. Are you eager to learn and quality-focused? Then this could be the opportunity for you! ✅

Sound like the job for you? Apply now and discover how you can make a difference!

Who are we looking for?

• You have some initial stable experience in a production environment ⚙️
• You speak English well; Dutch is a plus.
• You have your own means of transportation (public transport is not available).
• You are attentive and have an eye for detail. 👀
• You can work at a fast pace and are physically fit. 💪
• You are not afraid of physically demanding work.

Do you have a strong eye for detail and a structured way of working that ensures high-quality results? Then we are looking for you!
 

At Legend Biotech, you’ll have the chance to make a real difference. Your work will directly contribute to improving the lives of sick patients around the world.
 

No experience yet? No worries, we’ll teach you everything you need to know. Just like we take great care of our patients, we also take care of our employees.
 

Your responsibilities include:
 

 
• You assist with daily quality analyses and help ensure reliable test results.
 
• You check, clean, and disinfect equipment, and manage lab materials and waste.
 
• You ensure safe and accurate sample transfers between departments.
 
• You assist with various analyses in the labs.
 
• You accurately log all your tasks in logs, forms, or the quality system. 

 
• You have a Bachelor's degree in a scientific field, and/or experience in a Quality- related role.
 
• You work detail- oriented with precision.
 
• You have a strong quality- mindset.
 
• You have a clean and accurate working style.
 
• You like to collaborate with others.
 
• You speak English well.
 
• You are comfortable working with a laptop and MS-Office.
 
• You live nearby Ghent and can easily commute to work, even without public transportation.
 
• You are flexible and able to work in shifts.

You will start up the production process, operate the machines, and oversee smooth operations. In case of malfunctions, you will troubleshoot them or call in a technician. You follow the production planning and ensure efficient communication with colleagues. Additionally, you actively participate on the production floor.

What are we looking for?

• You are able to work very independently
• You have a strong sense of responsibility and know how to take action
• You have some technical insight
• You have a good knowledge of English or Dutch
• You are willing to work in 2 shifts
• It is a plus if you can operate a forklift

For our client in the ICHTEGEM region, we are looking for a CE TIPPER TRUCK DRIVER.

Our client is a family-owned company specialized in bulk transport, concrete transport, tipper truck transport and traction transport.

As a CE TIPPER TRUCK DRIVER in ICHTEGEM, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

  • Delivering soil and waste materials from earthworks using a tipper truck;
  • Transporting and delivering materials in accordance with safety regulations and applicable instructions;
  • Cleaning the truck;
  • Communicating with customers in a friendly and professional manner;
  • Unloading the truck at construction sites and driving back to reload.
As a CE DRIVER in NIEUWPOORT, you can identify with the following:

  • Experience as a CE DRIVER;
  • You are in possession of a CE driving licence, a valid Code 95 and a driver card;
  • You speak Dutch OR English OR French.

Are you an experienced asphalt worker who enjoys rolling up your sleeves?

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced asphalt worker to join our asphalt crew.

What does your job involve?

  • You assist the asphalt crew with the preparation, laying and finishing of hot-mix asphalt;
  • You help ensure the correct distribution and finishing of the asphalt;
  • You are responsible for touching up and finishing asphalt around joints and connections;
  • You help create a smooth and high-quality road surface;
  • You work closely with machine operators, roller operators, drivers and other colleagues on site;
  • You work with modern machinery, techniques and tools;
  • You depart daily from Oostende.
What do we expect from you?

  • You have experience in asphalt works, preferably as an asphalt worker;
  • You have knowledge of the different steps involved in laying and finishing hot-mix asphalt;
  • You are physically fit and enjoy active, hands-on work;
  • You are flexible and have no problem working in different weather conditions;
  • You speak fluent Dutch or English;
  • You are able to get to our depot in Oostende independently every day.

Are you an experienced roller operator with a passion for asphalt works?

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced roller operator for our asphalt works.

What does your job involve?

  • You independently operate the road roller during asphalt works.
  • You ensure the correct and even compaction of the asphalt according to the required quality standards.
  • You take into account the temperature and composition of the asphalt and adapt your working method accordingly.
  • You work closely with machine operators, drivers and other colleagues in the asphalt crew.
  • You help monitor the quality of the road surface and ensure that the works are carried out accurately.
  • You work with modern machines, techniques and tools.
  • You carry out daily checks and help ensure the proper maintenance of the machine.
  • You depart daily from the depot in Oostende.
What do we expect from you?

  • You have experience as a road roller operator, preferably in asphalt or road construction.
  • You have a good understanding of asphalt compaction and understand the importance of using the correct rolling technique.
  • You have good technical insight and can work confidently with modern machinery.
  • You are flexible and have no problem working in different weather conditions.
  • You speak fluent Dutch or English.
  • You are able to get to our depot in Oostende independently every day.

For the strengthening of our team, we are looking for a truck driver with a Category C driving licence to operate our emulsion truck.

You will depart from our depot in Oostende and drive to various construction sites throughout West Flanders. In addition to the transport, you will also be responsible for the correct application and processing of the emulsion on site, meaning you will be active both behind the wheel and on the construction site.

Your responsibilities:

  • You transport emulsion from our depot in Oostende to various construction sites throughout West Flanders;
  • You are responsible for the correct and safe loading and unloading of emulsion;
  • You operate the emulsion truck's equipment and ensure the correct application of the emulsion;
  • You work both with machinery and manually during the processing of emulsion on site.



What do we expect from you?

  • You have a valid Category C driving licence.
  • Code 95 is NOT required.
  • You have good technical insight and are willing to learn how the emulsion truck operates and how emulsion is processed on site.
  • You speak and understand sufficient Dutch or English to communicate safely and smoothly with your colleagues.

Would you like to help build high-quality roads throughout West Flanders? Then we would love to hear from you!

For our client in the Veurne area, we are looking for a DIAGNOSTIC TECHNICIAN.

Our client is a well-known garage in Veurne with a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere. They are looking for a new colleague to join their team.

They are a well-established garage with a modern, clean and fully equipped workshop.

As a DIAGNOSTIC TECHNICIAN in the Veurne area, your responsibilities will include:

  • Working independently on cars and vans;
  • Carrying out technical and electrical maintenance on passenger cars and vans;
  • Performing diagnostics on vehicles;
  • Dismantling and repairing engines;
  • Replacing timing belts.
As a DIAGNOSTIC TECHNICIAN in the Veurne area, you meet the following requirements:

  • You have experience as a vehicle mechanic, preferably with experience as a diagnostic technician;
  • You are in possession of a valid category B driving licence;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

Are you an independent electrician who enjoys working on technical projects and is not afraid of a new challenge?

Would you like to work on ships and join a working environment where you are given a lot of responsibility and freedom?

For a growing company specialized in ship repair and technical maintenance, we are looking for a SHIP ELECTRICIAN.

As a SHIP ELECTRICIAN, your responsibilities will include:

  • Carrying out electrical maintenance and repair work on ships;
  • Working on different ships, both at the workshop in Ostend and on-site throughout West Flanders;
  • Starting on site and working independently on the planned tasks;
  • Performing electrical tests and inspections;
  • Disconnecting electrical components and wiring from engines;
  • Troubleshooting electrical faults and finding suitable solutions;
  • Carrying out electrical interventions and repairs;
  • Actively thinking along with technical challenges and independently looking for solutions.
As a SHIP ELECTRICIAN in OSTEND, you recognize yourself in the following:

  • You have a technical education or background, preferably in industrial electricity;
  • You speak Dutch OR English;
  • You have a driving licence B;
  • You preferably have experience in an industrial environment;
  • Experience in the maritime sector is a plus, but not an absolute requirement;
  • You are able to work independently and do not need constant supervision;
  • You are a real problem-solver who takes initiative and looks for solutions yourself;
  • You are not afraid to take responsibility.

Are you an independent mechanic who enjoys working on technical projects and is not afraid of a new challenge?

Would you like to work on ships and join an environment where you are given a lot of responsibility and freedom?

For a growing company specialised in ship repair and technical maintenance, we are looking for a MARINE MECHANIC.

As a SHIP MECHANIC, your responsibilities will include:

  • Performing mechanical maintenance and repairs on ships;
  • Working on different vessels, both at the workshop in Ostend and on-site throughout West Flanders;
  • Starting on-site and working independently on the scheduled tasks;
  • Being responsible for the maintenance, dismantling and assembly of mechanical components;
  • Working on engines, drive systems, pumps and other mechanical installations;
  • Detecting mechanical faults and defects and providing suitable solutions;
  • Carrying out mechanical interventions and repairs;
  • Checking and testing installations after completing the work;
  • Actively thinking along with technical issues and independently looking for solutions.
As a MARINE MECHANIC in OSTEND, you recognise yourself in the following:

  • You have a technical education or background, preferably in industrial mechanics;
  • You speak Dutch OR English;
  • You have a valid driving licence B;
  • Previous experience in an industrial environment is preferred;
  • Experience in the maritime sector is a plus, but not an absolute requirement;
  • You can work independently and do not need constant supervision;
  • You are proactive and resourceful and know how to find solutions yourself;
  • You are willing to take responsibility.

For our client, we are looking for a PLASTERER.

As an all-round plasterer, you will be responsible for various plastering and finishing works. You will work on both interior and exterior projects and ensure a neat and high-quality finish every time.

Your responsibilities as a PLASTERER:

  • Carrying out plastering works;
  • Preparing surfaces;
  • Applying and finishing interior and exterior plaster;
  • Repairing and touching up existing plasterwork;
  • Finishing corners, edges and connections;
  • Working with spray cork;
  • Working with different materials and techniques;
  • Ensuring a neat and high-quality finish;
  • Working on different construction sites and projects.
This is you as a PLASTERER:

  • You have experience as a plasterer or renovation worker;
  • You can work independently, but also work well as part of a team;
  • You have an eye for detail and deliver a neat finish;
  • You are physically fit;
  • You speak Dutch or fluent Englisch;
  • You have a valid category B driving licence.

For a customer in Peer we are looking for motivated employees in dayshift.

Do you have a good feeling for fashion? Are you available in dayshift? You are not allergic for dust? 

 

As sorting emplyee you have the following tasks:

• You have a passion for fashion and modern clothing.

• You sort the clothing based on size, quality and fashion

• You quality check the clothing

• You start with the simpeler tasks and gradually the difficulty will improve

• Keeping the work environment tight and clean

As sorting employee we are looking for this profile:

• No experience required, everything can be learned

• You dont have dust allergy

• You have a passion for fashion and modern clothing.

• You speak Dutch or English well.

• You are results-driven, stress-resistant, and flexible.

jobs.occupation: Inside sales | German market | 100% on site in Antwerp
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international company operating within the food sector. With a family-business mindset, entrepreneurial spirit, and strong growth ambitions, they offer a fast-paced environment where initiative and results are highly valued.

Jobomschrijving

•  Proactively identify and develop new business opportunities within the German market.
• Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers and prospects.
• Manage the full sales cycle, from lead generation to closing deals.
• Conduct commercial negotiations and follow up on sales opportunities.
• Expand the customer portfolio and strengthen market presence.
• Analyze sales performance and market trends.
• Report on sales activities and contribute to the overall sales strategy.

•  Fluent in German and English, knowledge of Dutch or additional languages is a strong asset.
• Previous experience in sales, business development, or a commercial role.
• Strong commercial acumen and a results-oriented mindset.
• A true go-getter with the drive to open new doors and create opportunities.
• Confident communicator with excellent relationship-building skills.
• Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to learn.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• Affinity with the food industry is an advantage.
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is a plus.

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

CE Driver Wanted in the Port of Antwerp

For a logistics company located in the Port of Antwerp, we are looking for an experienced and motivated CE Driver.

As a driver, you will be responsible for the safe and timely transport of bulk goods and containers to and from various locations in and around the port. You will join a professional transport environment where safety, punctuality and clear communication are key.

What will you do?

• You are responsible for container transport to and from the Port of Antwerp.
• You collect containers from terminals and deliver them to customers.
• You carry out national transport, mainly within Belgium and the surrounding region.
• You check the load and ensure that containers are properly and safely secured.
• You ensure the correct handling of transport documents.
• You stay in contact with the planning department and communicate any problems or delays.
• You comply with the applicable safety regulations in the port.
• You are responsible for the proper inspection and care of your truck and trailer.

You will mainly work from the Port of Antwerp and carry out predominantly national and regional routes.

Interested?

Apply today and discover whether this position as a CE Driver in the Port of Antwerp is the right opportunity for you!

REF: MEC1

• You have a valid CE driving licence and Code 95
• Previous experience with container transport is preferred.
• Experience driving in the Port of Antwerp is a strong advantage.
• An  ADR certificate is a strong advantage.
• You are a safe and responsible driver.
• You are punctual, reliable and customer-oriented.
• You can work independently, while communicating smoothly with the planning department.
• You are flexible and have no problem with the dynamic nature of port and transport work.
• You have a sufficient level of  English to communicate smoothly.

As an ELECTROMECHANIC – DAY SHIFT in WEST FLANDERS, you will work closely with our clients to ensure the optimal performance and efficiency of their machinery and contribute to their operational success.

Your responsibilities as an ELECTROMECHANIC in WEST FLANDERS:

  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical and electrical faults, including under time pressure;
  • Carry out preventive maintenance according to the maintenance schedule;
  • Actively contribute ideas for improvements related to machinery, safety, quality and efficiency;
  • Participate in optimization and continuous improvement projects;
  • Contribute to a smooth and efficient production environment;
  • Work in a refrigerated production environment (4–6°C) that is cleaned industrially on a daily basis. Safety, cleanliness and quality are key priorities.
AS AN ELECTROMECHANIC IN WEST FLANDERS, YOU RECOGNIZE YOURSELF IN THE FOLLOWING:
  • You have a degree in electromechanics or relevant experience as a maintenance or breakdown technician, with a strong focus on electrical systems;
  • You have an analytical mindset and can quickly identify and resolve technical faults efficiently;
  • You can work independently and take responsibility in a mature and professional manner;
  • You have a good command of Dutch or English;
  • You are motivated to grow and develop within a company that is continuously expanding.

Apply now for this vacancy or send your CV to westkust@absolutejobs.be.

Our client is a european fintech operating in the financial services and payments sector. Its Brussels-based offices offer a dynamic, modern and easily accessible working environment within a rapidly evolving industry.

Jobomschrijving

• Act as the AML Compliance Officer and oversee the organisation's AML/CFT framework
• Supervise KYC, CDD, sanctions screening, PEP reviews and transaction monitoring activities
• Manage, coach and develop a team of 6 compliance professionals
• Review and validate complex investigations and escalate sensitive cases when required
• Maintain and enhance AML/CFT policies, procedures and internal controls
• Coordinate regulatory reporting, audits and compliance reviews
• Collaborate closely with legal, risk and operational teams to ensure regulatory compliance

• Unlimited right to work in Belgium is mandatory for this position : applications without a valid work permit will not be considered.

• Degree in Law, Finance, Compliance, Risk Management or a related field
• Minimum 7 years of experience in AML/CFT, compliance or financial crime within financial services, payments or fintech
• Fluent in English; proficiency in French and/or Dutch is considered an advantage
• Strong knowledge of Belgian and European AML regulations, KYC/CDD, sanctions and transaction monitoring
• Excellent analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills
• Proven experience leading and developing compliance teams

Our client is looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager to join its Transformation Office and lead strategic digital and business transformation initiatives. This role offers the opportunity to manage high-impact projects at the intersection of technology, customer experience, operational excellence, and organizational change.

More than a traditional project management position, this role requires a true project owner. The successful candidate will be expected to take accountability for decisions, drive alignment across stakeholders, challenge where necessary, and ensure projects deliver measurable business value from conception through implementation.

Jobomschrijving

Project Leadership & Ownership

• Lead transformation projects from initial scoping and business case development through to successful delivery and adoption.
• Define project scope, requirements, objectives, budgets, timelines, and success criteria in collaboration with business stakeholders and Business Analysts.
• Take full ownership of project outcomes, making informed decisions and managing priorities, risks, and dependencies throughout the project lifecycle.
• Ensure delivery within scope, budget, and timelines while maintaining a strong focus on business value realization.
• Monitor project performance through KPIs and provide structured reporting to senior management.

Stakeholder Management & Governance

• Build strong relationships with sponsors, business leaders, and cross-functional teams.
• Prepare and lead steering committees, facilitating discussions and driving decision-making.
• Influence, challenge, and align stakeholders to ensure project objectives are achieved.
• Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including executive and C-level management.
• Foster collaboration between business and technology teams to support successful transformation outcomes.

Continuous Improvement & Transformation Excellence

• Contribute to the development and enhancement of project management standards, methodologies, and governance practices.
• Share knowledge and best practices across the organization.
• Support a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence.
• Play an active role in strengthening project delivery capabilities across the business.

• Master's degree in Business, Management, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
• Minimum 10 years of experience in Project or Program Management.
• Strong track record delivering complex transformation, digital, or business change projects.
• Experience operating within large and complex stakeholder environments.
• Strong affinity with digital technologies and IT-driven transformation.
• Expertise in project management methodologies, risk management, business case development, and governance.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
• Structured, results-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities.
• Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
• Confident decision-maker who takes responsibility for outcomes.
• Comfortable working autonomously while influencing senior stakeholders.
• Proactive, resilient, and delivery-focused.
• Fluent in Dutch, French, and English.

Our client is a well-established manufacturing company with a strong presence in Belgium and an international footprint.

Jobomschrijving

 Key Responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end supply chain activities
• Manage planning, inventory and logistics processes
• Develop and monitor KPIs and performance metrics
• Improve forecasting accuracy and stock management
• Collaborate with production, procurement and sales teams
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives
• Manage suppliers and logistics partners
• Lead and develop the supply chain team

 Candidate Profile

• Bachelor's or Master's degree
• At least 5 years of experience in a manufacturing environment
• Proven experience in supply chain management
• Strong knowledge of planning, inventory and logistics
• Experience with ERP systems
• Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills
• Fluent Dutch, French and English is mandatory
• Hands-on, analytical and solution-oriented mindset
